'''Darth Rictus''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Dark Council]]. As head of the [[Sphere of Mysteries]], Rictus held the title of Keeper of Mysteries.

==Biography==
By [[3640 BBY]], Rictus was the oldest member of the Council, even older than the 76-year-old [[Darth Vowrawn]]. It was because of this that his opinion of matters was well-respected by the other Councilors. Despite his age, he maintained his status as a powerful Sith and an incredibly competent duelist, though he tended to refrain from physical combat. He also seemed to believed that aliens did not have a place on the Dark Council, asking Darth Marr if he was afraid of Karrid.<ref name="Annihilation" />

After [[Darth Karrid]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Darth Gravus]] in an attempt to earn [[Darth Hadra]]'s now-vacant Dark Council seat, Rictus changed his tune and spoke in support of her, saying that she had acted like a true [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Annihilation" />

In the midst of the [[Dread Masters]] crisis, Rictus initiated the founding of the [[Dread Executioners]] to eliminate the Dread Masters, whose base of operations was discovered on [[Oricon]].<ref name="Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Rictus was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a reference guide for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' published by [[Dorling Kindersley]] on [[October 15]], [[2012]].

The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' quest "An Invitation From Darth Acina" is named in the game's files as "An Invitation From Darth Rictus."
